title: Towards a Holistic Evaluation of LLMs on Factual Knowledge Recall
findings: The paper found that the domain of knowledge, including religion, is less predictive of a model's knowledge recall performance compared to factors like knowledge popularity (how well-known a fact is) and property type. As shown in Figure 3, model performance in the 'religion' domain was generally flat and comparable to its performance in other domains such as 'law', 'food', and 'travel', indicating no specific strengths or weaknesses related to religious topics were identified.
